domain_tree.title: Justice, Safety, and Restoration
domain_tree.central_promise: A just society protects people from harm without surrendering the humanity of those who have caused harm. It holds wrongdoing accountable, repairs what can be repaired, and never converts punishment into permanent power over a person’s life.

domain_tree.title: Public Service and the 21st-Century State
domain_tree.central_promise: Government should become invisible—but never unaccountable. Continuously reduce administrative friction while improving public service; automate the routine, elevate the human; organize around life events, not agency charts.
domain_tree.iconic_phrase: Government should become invisible—but never unaccountable.
domain_tree.research_domain_title: Government Capacity, Public Service, and Institutional Modernization

domain_tree.title: Human Capital Doctrine
domain_tree.central_promise: Every child deserves a meaningful pathway to productive adulthood. Build human capital infrastructure — multiple respected pathways of equal dignity — and pilot regional academies that make home stronger.
domain_tree.research_domain_title: Human Capital Infrastructure, Pathways, and Regional Academies

domain_tree.title: Essential Systems
domain_tree.central_promise: Design essential systems so private innovation and investment are rewarded while the public interest remains protected — evaluate banking, insurance, healthcare, and pharmaceuticals through incentives and outcomes, not inherent-corruption conclusions.
chapter_method: What is this system supposed to accomplish?
Where are the incentives well aligned, and where are they not?
What reforms would better align the system with Constitutional Capitalism?

domain_tree.title: Democracy, Representation, and Distributed Government
domain_tree.central_promise: Political authority is held in trust, never owned. Power must remain divided, visible, reviewable, locally rooted where possible, and continuously returnable to the people.

domain_tree.title: Constitutional Transparency and the People's Ledger
domain_tree.central_promise: Government holds public information in trust: presumed open unless a constitutionally or legally justified reason protects it — every public dollar and major action leaves a reviewable trail.
domain_tree.research_domain_title: Constitutional Transparency, Public Records, and Accountability Systems

life_path_tree.title: A Child
life_path_tree.prompt: What does Constitutional Capitalism mean for someone born today?

essential_infrastructure_principle.text: Essential infrastructure that enables participation in modern economic life should be broadly accessible.
essential_infrastructure_principle.note: Principle before institutional model. Public, private, cooperative, or hybrid solutions remain open design questions.
